hero.lead: I'm Yayan Faturrohman. I design and build management systems, web apps, and mobile apps for government agencies and businesses across Indonesia. Built by me directly, no middlemen.

services.title: Three things I do.
services.subtitle: From the first conversation to a system running on your server, and kept healthy after that.
services.web.title: Web development
services.web.desc: Management information systems, agency dashboards, internal portals, and business apps. Laravel backend, MySQL database, Tailwind CSS interface.
services.mobile.title: Mobile apps
services.mobile.desc: Android and iOS apps with React Native, connected to the same API as your web system. Shipped all the way to the Play Store and App Store.
services.maintenance.title: System maintenance
services.maintenance.desc: Server upkeep, database tuning, security updates, and new features for systems already in production, including ones I didn't build.

approach.custom.title: Written from scratch, for your workflow.

approach.pricing.title: Priced per scope, not a subscription.
approach.pricing.desc: You know the cost before we start. No forced monthly fees, no lock-in.

approach.direct.desc: You talk directly with the person doing the work. Fast replies on WhatsApp, and familiarity with Indonesian public-sector procedures.
